description: Look up anime on AniPub, the free community catalogue of about 8,000 titles. Search by title, read a title's poster, synopsis, genres, airing status, episode count and MyAnimeList score, pull its MyAnimeList record and cast with voice actors, browse by genre or by rating, and filter by title, genres and score range. Also checks whether a title is listed and how big the catalogue has grown. No account or API key required.
